svg.title: README Raid: Frieren vs Aura
svg.desc: Encounter 1. Frieren 26/26 HP. Aura 100/100 HP. Mana: Frieren 240/240, Aura 40/60. CD · GUARD: READY · ULT: READY. Aura spends 15 mana to guard. Your damage is halved, rounded up. Not charged.

g.title: Frieren: Ultimate not ready. Requires charge, 80 MP, no cooldown, and a completed turn.
Aura: Army Assault not ready. Requires the Assault turn, 30 MP, and a completed turn.
